bullets.text: Copilot Connectors Rollout - **Microsoft** Copilot now connects to **OneDrive**, **Outlook**, and **Google** services for seamless content access.
AI Supercomputing Milestone - **Microsoft Azure** launches the first large-scale cluster with **NVIDIA** GB300 NVL72 for advanced AI workloads.
Cloud Expansion in Asia - **Microsoft** is investing billions to enhance its cloud infrastructure across Asia, launching new **Azure** datacenter regions.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build introduces an updated Start menu and enhanced app accessibility.
Microsoft Ignite 2025 - **Microsoft Ignite** focuses on security innovations and practical solutions for security professionals.
Disrupting Teams Threats - Guidance provided by **Microsoft** to enhance security against threats targeting **Microsoft Teams**.
AI Toolkit for VS Code - New **AI Toolkit** simplifies generative AI app development for **Visual Studio Code** users.
Enhancing Security Practices - **Microsoft** introduces new patterns and practices to strengthen security through the **Secure Future Initiative**.
